heading: ### 6. Email (SMTP)
proposed: **Local testing with Mailpit:** run a mail catcher such as Mailpit locally; the app only knows an SMTP host and port, so for local runs point them at `localhost:1025` (no TLS) in `judo-karaf.env`. Also set `JUDO_PLATFORM_MAIL_SMTP_USER` and `JUDO_PLATFORM_MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD` to any value, with `JUDO_PLATFORM_MAIL_SMTP_AUTH=false`: the mail service (`JavaMailSenderActivator`) is only created when the log SMTP server is on or user, password and host are all set, so host and port alone give no `EmailService`.
replaces: **Local testing with Mailpit:** run a mail catcher such as Mailpit locally; the app only knows an SMTP host and port, so for local runs point them at `localhost:1025` (no authentication, no TLS) in `judo-karaf.env`.

heading: ### When No Manual Step Is Needed
proposed: Adding a **stored** member (for example a new attribute) to an entity needs **no** manual migration or `schema-upgrade` run for a fresh database (empty or newly created, so Liquibase creates everything). For an existing database with rows, the new column is filled with NULL, not with the attribute's model default; for a value other than NULL, write a backfill changeset (see [migration backfill](../../best-practices/backend/migration-backfill-default-where-null.md)).
replaces: Adding a **stored** member (for example a new attribute) to an entity needs **no** manual migration or `schema-upgrade` run for a fresh database (empty or newly created, so Liquibase creates everything).
